spec.query:
from(bucket: "my-bucket")
  |> range(
       start: 0,
       stop: v.timeRangeStop
     )
  |> filter(
       fn: (r) =>
       r["_measurement"] == "composition" and r["_field"] == "bmi"
     )
  |> drop(
       columns: [
         "_measurement",
         "_start",
         "_stop"
       ]
     )
  |> group()
  |> pivot(
       rowKey: [
         "_time"
       ],
       columnKey: ["_field"],
       valueColumn: "_value"
     )
  |> sort(
       columns: ["_time"],
       desc: false
     )
